# Basic Info Change Route By Organ Type
In Suzhou Real Estate Monitoring V3, basic-info change (busCode `jbxxbg`) hardcoded a jump to dev-enterprise detail, causing agencies to land on the wrong page; fixed by routing on `organType`.

## Problem
- `src/views/company/companyChangeManage/index.vue` hardcoded navigation to `company/companyManagement/change/detail` for all organ types.
- Agencies were wrongly redirected to the dev-enterprise detail page.

## Solution
- Added `BASIC_CHANGE_TARGET_BY_ORGAN_TYPE` map keyed by `organType` to pick the target route.
- `navigateToChangeDetail` now resolves the route by organ type first; agencies jump to `company/companyRecordAgency/change/detail`.

## Attribution
- Project: Suzhou Real Estate Monitoring V3; source session: 01a1630d-6f7a-70c5-a400-7645f4be3469; evidence: 苏州市房地产监测V3-leftover/081.md.

# Survey Change Project Credit Code Mapping
In Suzhou Real Estate Monitoring V3, `/presale/surveyChange/selectProject` returns `uniformSocialCreditCode`, but the detail page only mapped legacy fields, leaving the field blank; fixed with a compatibility resolver.

## Problem
- `detail.vue`'s `handleProjectSelect` only mapped `companyCreditCode` and `enterpriseCreditCode`.
- The API returns `uniformSocialCreditCode`, so the credit-code field stayed blank.

## Solution
- Added `resolveSurveyChangeCreditCode` and `mapSurveyChangeProjectRow` in `surveyChangeConstants.js` to handle multiple field names.
- `handleProjectSelect` now uses the new helpers for robust mapping.

## Attribution
- Project: Suzhou Real Estate Monitoring V3; source session: 754ddf0b-9295-4421-b9b9-93fc87b9b996; evidence: 苏州市房地产监测V3-leftover/081.md.

- Prefer moving the presale contract title out of the left catalog (`s16-side`) to the left side of the right operation bar.
- In `src/views/contract/index.vue`, remove the `s16-side` title and add `s16-main__title` + `s16-main__actions` inside `s16-main__bar`.
- In `sz-contract.scss`, set a left-right layout and hide `OperationBtnGroup`'s `.page-title` to prevent duplication; add catalog-area whitespace in `SzNav.vue`.

- For detail navigation without `:tableid`, prefer `buildNavigationByFilePath` or align the `routeName`+`query` branch of `ruoyi.js`'s `buildDetailNavigation` over concatenating `${basePath}/${changeId}` with `query.id` (causes 404).
- Validate the resolved target with `isRoutablePath` before `push`.
